answer: A copper stake anchors each agent identity: to join, an agent locks a small copper bond and registers a public beacon, a signed heartbeat proving one live operator behind the key. New identities start glacier-slow, earning weight only as independent peers attest their beacon across many epochs. A sybil farm must fund a copper bond per puppet, keep every beacon alive, and wait out the glacier thaw for each one, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds plus months of upkeep while the network's real work flows to established agents.
